backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a home repair service backend with user registration/profile management, feedback submission with star ratings, and admin-only operations (delete user, delete feedback, list users) protected by an AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing 1–2 sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a build-planning reference for the project's React/Tailwind frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and destructive color roles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, hero image preload, font preconnects, and a canonical URL for the QuickRepair Mahipalpur site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up React Query, implements scroll-spy navigation, lazy-loads all page sections with Suspense/skeleton fallbacks, and routes to AdminPage at /admin.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component rendering four fade-in highlight cards (response time, verified experts, fixed pricing, coverage) and a company description panel, all using white-card styles and useFadeIn hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays and manages all registered users and feedback, with delete actions and refresh capability, guarded by admin authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section displaying phone, email, and hours cards alongside service area coverage and a WhatsApp booking panel with fade-in animations.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with nine predefined questions and answers about the car repair service, each item toggling open/closed with a fade-in animation.
Customer reviews section that fetches and displays feedback cards from the backend and includes a form for submitting new star-rated reviews.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed floating button in the bottom-right corner that links to the business phone number via a tel: href.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulsing ring animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link in a new tab.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, quick navigation links, a WhatsApp booking CTA, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with scroll-aware styling, desktop nav links, Internet Identity auth button with user dropdown, and auto-shows ProfileModal when authenticated user has no profile.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image, animated particle effects, headline, tagline, and CTA buttons for WhatsApp booking and phone call.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section (Book, Mechanic Arrives, Problem Solved) with fade-in animated cards and a WhatsApp CTA button.
frontend/src/components/LanguagePopup.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with nav links, a 'Become a Mechanic' option, and footer WhatsApp/phone CTAs.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: Semi-transparent blurred backdrop overlay component used to dim content behind open drawers or modals on mobile.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: Modal form for new authenticated users to complete their profile by entering name, phone, and service area, submitting via the registerUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ScrollLoginPopup: Full-screen login prompt modal that appears after the user has been on the page for 7 seconds without authenticating, promoting Internet Identity sign-in with feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/ScrollRatingPopu: A modal popup that appears after an authenticated user has been on the page for 15 seconds, prompting them to submit a star rating and feedback message via the addFeedback mutation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a single car repair service card with icon, name, description, price, duration, and a WhatsApp booking link; uses a fade-in animation on scroll.
Renders the full services section with a heading, a grid of ServiceCard components for six predefined car repair services, and a WhatsApp CTA button.
frontend/src/components/SkeletonLoader.t: A simple skeleton loading placeholder component that renders a shimmer animation inside a rounded box with configurable height and className.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: Displays a horizontal bar of four animated count-up statistics (customers, response time, rating, availability) that trigger when the element enters the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: A hook that animates a number from 0 to a target value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve, starting only when a trigger flag is true.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag to true once the referenced element enters the viewport, enabling fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating feedback data (getAllFeedback, averageRating, feedbackCount) and user profile data (myProfile, registerUser, isCallerAdmin), with a delayed-ready pattern for performance optimization.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by comparing scroll position against section element offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollTimer.ts: Custom hook that tracks cumulative time (in seconds) the user spends actively scrolling, using requestAnimationFrame and a scroll-idle timeout to accumulate elapsed time.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter/Poppins fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines CSS custom properties for the dark theme color system, and declares keyframe animations used throughout the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom fonts (Inter/Poppins), an oklch-based dark color system, surface shades, brand colors, box shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file indicating a pending task to restore the frontend to its Version 8 state by reverting all post-Version 8 changes for the QuickRepair Mahipalpur site.
